title: Encode File Blob as Data Uri
description: File blobs should not be pure base64 encoded strings, but encoded as data URIs (data:<mime>;base64,<data>) using the file's mime type or application/octet-stream as fallback. Update import_kit/export_kit (encode/decode) in Go (kit_sqlite.go, semio_test.go), TypeScript (semio.ts), Python (semio.py, semio.test.py), and C# (Semio.cs). All tests must pass.
